📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-08-25
1. IBM Unveils First Dual-Architecture Chip Running Both Mainframe and Arm Workloads產品
IBM公布首個能執行主機及Arm應用的雙架構晶片
IBM revealed its Dual-Architecture Processor at Hot Chips, the first next-gen chip platform letting native Arm Linux run alongside z/OS and Linux on IBM Z. It stems from IBM's April partnership with Arm and will power future IBM Z mainframes and LinuxONE systems.
IBM在Hot Chips大會發表雙架構處理器，首度讓Arm原生Linux與z/OS及Linux on IBM Z並存執行。此晶片源自IBM與Arm今年4月的合作，將用於未來的IBM Z主機與LinuxONE系統。
iThome · 原文連結
2. Humanoid Robot Shatters Human 100m and 400m Sprint Records產業
人形機器人首度打破100米及400米短跑人類紀錄
At the second World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing, the Tiangong Ultra robot ran the 100m in 9.39 seconds, beating Usain Bolt's 9.58s record, then won the 400m in 38.15 seconds, faster than Wayde van Niekerk's 2016 Olympic mark.
第二屆世界人形機器人運動會上，北京研發的天工Ultra在100米跑出9.39秒，超越Usain Bolt的9.58秒世界紀錄；隔日又以38.15秒奪得400米冠軍，快於2016年里約奧運紀錄，寫下首例。
iThome · 原文連結
3. Instinct's Powerful AI Assistant Raises Privacy and Security Concerns資安
AI助理Instinct功能強大，隱私與資安疑慮浮現
Early testers praise what Instinct's AI assistant can do, but its sweeping account access, broad terms of service, and ability to act on users' behalf are drawing scrutiny over privacy and security trade-offs.
早期使用者盛讚AI助理Instinct的強大功能，但其廣泛的帳號存取權限、寬鬆使用條款，以及可代替使用者行動的能力，也引發隱私與資安疑慮。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
4. Hugging Face Reportedly in Talks to Be Acquired for $13B產業
傳Hugging Face洽談以130億美元被收購
Hugging Face has reportedly been fielding acquisition offers valuing the company at around $13 billion, though the founders' sense of responsibility to the open-source community raises doubts over whether a deal will happen.
據報導，Hugging Face近期接獲多項收購提案，估值約130億美元，但創辦人對開源社群的責任感，讓外界懷疑這筆交易是否真的會成真。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
5. AI Is Hitting Entry-Level Jobs Hardest, Stanford Study Finds研究
史丹佛研究：AI衝擊基層職缺最為嚴重
A new Stanford study finds employment for young workers in AI-exposed fields has fallen 19% compared with occupations more resistant to automation, highlighting AI's disproportionate impact on entry-level roles.
史丹佛最新研究發現，在容易受AI影響的領域中，年輕員工就業率較不易受衝擊的職業低了19%，顯示AI對基層職缺的衝擊尤為明顯。
Ars Technica · 原文連結
6. Valor, Point72 Back General Intuition at $6B Valuation as AI Startup Pushes Into Robotics產業
Valor、Point72投資General Intuition，估值達60億美元搶進機器人領域
General Intuition, which builds a foundation model training generalized AI agents to navigate space and time, is in talks to raise at a $6 billion pre-money valuation from investors including Valor Ventures, Point72 Ventures, and Seven Seven Six.
打造通用AI代理人基礎模型的新創公司General Intuition，正洽談以60億美元估值募資，投資方包括Valor Ventures、Point72 Ventures及Seven Seven Six，並將進軍機器人領域。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
7. Nvidia Unveils AVO Architecture to Let AI Models Complete Long-Running Tasks模型
Nvidia發表AVO架構，讓模型得以完成長時間任務
Nvidia introduced AVO (Agentic Variation Operators), an agent system rather than a new model, letting AI models continuously take actions, observe results, and revise strategy across multi-step, long-duration tasks.
Nvidia發表代理人架構AVO，並非新模型，而是搭配既有模型運作的系統，讓AI能持續執行多步驟長時間任務，並不斷觀察結果、修正策略。
iThome · 原文連結
8. Android Banking Trojan ToxicPanda 2.0 Expands to Target 349 Financial Apps資安
Android銀行木馬ToxicPanda 2.0擴大攻擊，瞄準349款金融應用
Security firm Zimperium found a new ToxicPanda 2.0 variant giving attackers 167 remote commands to control infected phones and display fake login screens across 349 banking, wallet, and crypto apps in 16 countries, stealing credentials and PINs.
資安業者Zimperium發現新版Android銀行木馬ToxicPanda 2.0，攻擊者可透過167種遠端指令控制受感染手機，針對16國349款金融應用顯示假登入畫面，竊取帳密與PIN碼。
iThome · 原文連結
9. Taiwan Passes Energy Law Amendment Requiring Large Power Users to Add Self-Generation Amid AI Demand政策
能管法三讀修正，因應AI用電需求，新設能源大戶須設自用發電或儲能設備
Taiwan's Legislative Yuan passed amendments to the Energy Administration Act requiring new large-capacity power users to install self-generation or energy storage equipment, a "Bring Your Own Power" measure aimed at surging AI data center electricity demand.
立法院三讀通過能源管理法修正案，新設或增設達一定容量的能源大用戶須設置自用發電或儲能設備，回應AI資料中心興起帶來的用電需求壓力。
iThome · 原文連結
10. Nvidia Senior Manager Linked to Supermicro Scheme Smuggling AI Servers to China政策
Nvidia資深經理涉入Supermicro案，遭控走私AI伺服器至中國
An Nvidia senior manager has been indicted in connection with a scheme allegedly smuggling AI servers to China, following earlier criticism from CEO Jensen Huang over Supermicro's role in similar smuggling activity.
一名Nvidia資深經理遭起訴，被控涉入將AI伺服器走私至中國的計畫，此前執行長黃仁勳已針對Supermicro牽涉的類似走私行為提出批評。
Ars Technica · 原文連結
